_meta.source_professional: Fall 2026 AKPsi Professional Interview Evaluation Form (Google Form)
_meta.note: Casual rubric descriptors were transcribed from a PDF with OCR artifacts. Every casual question carries needs_human_review. Questions 2 and 3 are known-bad: the tier text in the source appears displaced between tables and does not match the question prompt. Seed them as written, flag them in the admin question editor, and have the recruitment team correct the text before the cycle opens. Do not invent replacement rubric text.

opening: Introduce yourself, your role in AKPsi, as well as major and year.
Explain that we will be taking notes, but it's nothing to worry about.
Have PNMs introduce themselves with their year and major as well.
Questions will then be asked down the line by each interviewer.
closing: Due to the nature of the interview, please do not discuss interview questions or content with anyone outside of this room, including other potential new members.
interviewer_notes: Interviews must be kept to 15 minutes with 5 minutes of transition time.
Each brother is assigned one PNM to record answers for and score. One rubric per PNM.
If you know a PNM you cannot complete the rubric for them. Flag the conflict so a director can reassign you.
Do not discuss scores with your co-interviewers until after you have submitted.
Passion and genuine interest in growing is the main thing we want. An imperfect answer from a good fit can still earn a 1.5. Be honest and earnest.
Question 4 is a choice of four creative prompts. Coordinate with the other interviewers so all PNMs in the time slot receive the same one.

opening: Welcome to the Alpha Kappa Psi Professional Rush Interviews. We are excited to have you at this step of the process. Please remember to be yourself and be passionate.
Introduce yourselves. Traditionally, whoever asks the first question introduces themselves last.
Let's get started with our questions.
closing: Please make sure to keep {invite_event_dates} open in the event you are offered the opportunity to pledge. Additionally, you must be available every Monday and every Tuesday night, and occasionally Thursday nights.

Everything seen or heard during this interview is of a confidential nature and must not be shared with anyone who has not completed the pledging process. If we are made aware that what was said and asked here leaves the room, you will be removed from any further consideration. Do you understand?
professional.conditional_conflict_script: Shown only when the panelist has flagged knows_personally: "Regardless of any experiences you have had in the past with me or anyone else on the professional team, our relationship when it comes to Alpha Kappa Psi will remain professional, strictly professional, and nothing but professional. Is this understood?"
interviewer_notes: Designate one person, typically the person who is not E-Board or a professional advisor, to focus on taking notes while the rushee speaks. All panelists are still expected to take notes during the interview and score afterward.
If you do not complete your rubric in its entirety it is null and void. Every question requires a score before you can submit.

casual_questions.prompt: Creative question. Choose one and ask it to every PNM in this time slot: (1) It's a late weeknight and you are super tired, but your friends invite you to hang out with them. You know you have another busy day tomorrow. What do you do? (2) You find yourself working with a brother who has a completely different personality from you. How do you approach building a connection? (3) If you could only read one book for the rest of your life, what would it be? (4) If you could have dinner with any person from history, dead or alive, who would you choose?
casual_questions.help_text: Coordinate with the other interviewers. All PNMs in the time slot must receive the same prompt.

score_options.label: Good

score_options.label: Fair
